name: online_shoppers
description: The dataset consists of feature vectors belonging to 12,330 sessions.The dataset was formed so that each sessionwould belong to a different user in a 1-year period to avoidany tendency to a specific campaign, special day, userprofile, or period.Source: https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/Online+Shoppers+Purchasing+Intention+Dataset
creator: Yoontae Hwang, Youngbin Lee, Yongjae Lee
citation: Yoontae Hwang, Youngbin Lee, Yongjae Lee,Semi-Supervised Learning for Tabular Datasets with Continuous and Categorical Variables, Archive, 2023
